name: Carriage Hill Craft Metals
old_description: Carriage Hill Craft Metals is Proud to Have Acquired Port Sheet Metal
about:
Carriage Hill Craft Metals operates from Georgetown, Massachusetts, on the North Shore. The company was founded in 2018 by Chris Breen, a Rowley native who graduated from Whittier Regional Vocational Technical High School in 2008 and spent the next decade honing his metal fabrication skills before launching his own shop. Breen formed the business as a limited liability company after acquiring Port Sheet Metal, a local firm with a 40-year service history.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication services including shearing, braking, punching, band-saw cutting, MIG and TIG welding, grinding, and soldering. Equipment includes an automated single-turret Strip-It 18/30 punch capable of 1/4-inch plate, an apron brake that bends 14-gauge steel up to 10 feet, horizontal and vertical band saws that handle material up to 12-inch plate, and shearing capacity for 12-ounce copper through 11-gauge steel and 3/16-inch aluminum up to 8 feet long. Typical output ranges from copper countertops, bar tops, and artistic grindings to structural steel brackets, fireplace dampers, shower pans, flashing, and cupolas.

Customers include residential, commercial, and architectural clients across the North Shore region, with projects such as a Newburyport railing installation exceeding 150 feet and a Corten steel deck on the Newburyport riverfront. The company also serves contractors and designers seeking custom metalwork for building and renovation projects.

Breen started the business to apply his creativity and technical knowledge on his own terms, emphasizing the continuity of Port Sheet Metal's long-standing quality standards.
